title: Post-codec Full-copy service: retained first failure and independently audited successor

transformations.method: Exact known leading-root prefix aliases only. Every other parsed key/type/value unchanged.

limits: The complete first raw report object is retained, not a lossy selection. Original raw bytes remain unchanged locally; portable aliases cannot recreate original bytes or act as acquisition authority.

First campaign failed: 17 operation rows include six pre-spawn refusals; 11 actual children closed, zero targets, empty cases. All 11 actual child stderr streams are empty. Genuine startup media did occur; this is not a zero-media claim.

Six historical startup encode templates still contained obsolete global -c copy pairs. Exact argv admission refused the current commands before spawning; this is not six encoder failures, an unsupported runtime, or an app encoding defect.
All subsequent publication, collision, cancellation, recovery and access assertions were unreached. No successful service qualification follows from this stopped attempt.

The sibling successor independently passed four finite cases. Lead rehashed 333 identity occurrences / 320 unique files plus 668 current and Git source files. No source change occurred. Fixed cutoff excludes later native preparation outcomes.
Raw media, PCM, binaries/dependencies, gates and state payloads are excluded. No inverse path mapping, raw-runtime restoration or publication/native authority.

Successor supports two publications, actual post-preview sentinel Start refusal, positive-frame-10 cancellation with SIGKILL / 904-byte stderr and retained zero-byte stage, followed by NEW-owner recovery. This is not same-service restart.
Copied AAC packet/header/padding identities and decoded timing/counts are not PCM identity. Access uses an injected sink, not OS reveal. The known 11-second fixture is not a fresh held-out input.

Original helper retained whole output hashes and complete probes; audit rehashed them without new probe or decode. Both publication accounting contexts are truncated; all 106 bounded child stderr captures were independently hashed, with 11 nonempty and 95 empty.

Normal-service decoded-source validation is post-encode and pre-publication, not the calibration fail-first ordering. At cutoff native reuse feasibility was read-only complete and outside adaptation assigned; no accepted new helper, gate or native run.

limitations: Finite reused short/cancellation/new-instance proof only; no native/OS reveal/PCM/arbitrary-length/same-service recovery qualification.
Metadata before encoding; complete decoded source after encoding before publication.
Pre-child disk/size admission is not a hard active-write cap.
Abort request is not a guaranteed whole-process exit bound.
